title: Chapter 191 - 191 Returning To Jiangbei; Sister Arrives!
content:
Chapter 191 - 191 Returning To Jiangbei; Sister Arrives!

Chapter 191 - 191 Returning to Jiangbei; Sister Arrives!

191 Returning to Jiangbei; Sister Arrives!

At this moment, Ah Mei had washed her face several times and raised her head to ask, “Brother, Sister, is there anything dirty on my face?”

Her voice was very clear and pleasant, like the sound of spring water.

At this moment, it was like a stone thrown into a lake, setting off ripples and completely breaking the silence of the scene.

Su Ningjing recalled the scene just now, and her heart raced again. Her pretty face turned red, and she quickly lowered her head.

Lin Fan turned around and smiled, “Let me see… Mhm, there’s nothing else. Your face is very clean.”

“Alright!” Ah Mei said happily.

At this moment, an old man carrying a bamboo basket slowly walked over and said with a smile, “Young man, your farming skills are really good!”

Lin Fan said, “Grandpa, you flatter me. I just watched you and learned from there.”

…

In the blink of an eye, two days had passed.

In the past two days, Lin Fan had gone into the river to catch fish, climbed trees to pick fruits, and climbed mountains to pick flowers… He took a good look at the surrounding scenery.

Moreover, he planted all the top-grade coffee varieties on the hillside.

Today, Lin Fan packed his luggage and sat quietly in the Porsche Cayenne with Su Ningjing. Under the gazes of Granny, Sister, and Big Yellow, they sped toward the airport.

After all, the old lady’s body had completely recovered, and the top-grade coffee beans had been planted.

Although the air in the mountains was good and the environment was great…

Lin Fan felt that it was not suitable for him to stay for too long.

Perhaps, when he was old, he would choose to find a mountain forest and live a life in a garden.

Lin Fan parked the Porsche Cayenne in the airport parking lot.

Then, under the meticulous care of the stewardess, they passed through the VIP passage and lay down on the spacious first-class seats.

Rumble!

After a loud roar, the plane began to accelerate. Like a majestic goshawk, it pierced through the clouds and soared freely under the blue sky.

About two hours later, the plane finally landed steadily.

Then, Lin Fan drove the Pagani Huayra from the parking lot and sped toward the Coiling Dragon Villa.

When they arrived at Coiling Dragon Villa, the sun was setting.

Perhaps it was because of the sunset, Su Ningjing sniffed the empty villa and smelled Lin Fan’s scent. Her pretty face was as red as the setting sun.

At this moment, Lin Fan’s stomach suddenly let out a soft growl.

“I’ll go cook first,” Su Ningjing said hurriedly.

It had to be said that the refrigerator in Coiling Dragon Villa was indeed something that Lin Fan had spent 100,000 yuan to buy.

Even if the vegetables and meat were placed in the refrigerator for several days, there was no change at all.

With the sound of vegetables being washed and stir-fried, the kitchen began to fill with a fragrance that made one salivate.

After eating wild animals in the mountains for a few days, returning to the city for a meal gave Lin Fan a different feeling.

After eating, Lin Fan went to the bathroom to take a hot shower.

Then, he lay on the sofa leisurely and played with his phone.

Su Ningjing tidied up the kitchen and cleaned the villa again. Then, she went to the bathroom.

Lin Fan played with his phone for a long time and could not help but feel a little bored.

Hence, he turned his attention to the sign-in system.

He muttered in his heart, ‘These few days… I kept getting ten million. I hope that there’ll be something different today.’

“Sign in!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained 51% of Cha Yue’s shares.]

Cha Yue was a unique milk tea chain from Sha City, but it was also a famous milk tea brand in the country.

In Sha City, one could see a Cha Yue milk tea shop every few steps.

Even so, every Chayue shop was extremely popular.

Lin Fan touched his chin and said, “In other words, I’m now the biggest shareholder of Cha Yue? Today’s sign-in is barely considered good.”

Barely good?

Cha Yan had not been listed yet. Once it was listed, it would be estimated to be at least tens of billions!

In other words, Lin Fan had obtained billions of dollars worth of assets!

Creak!

At this moment, the bathroom door opened, and a thick mist filled the air.

Then, Su Ningjing, who was wearing loose white home clothes, slowly appeared.

At this moment, Su Ningjing’s black hair was still a little wet.

However, it was also because of this that her hair was even straighter, like a waterfall flowing down the river.

Snow-white skin, beautiful facial features, and a perfect figure!

In addition, the bathroom behind her was filled with mist…

At this moment, Su Ningjing seemed to have transformed into a fairy who had descended into the human world.

Su Ningjing saw that Lin Fan was staring at her, and she could not help but be at a loss.

She had just taken a shower, and her shoes were wet. They were already a little slippery, and she fell to the ground.

Lin Fan’s eyes were sharp, and his hands were fast. He took a big step forward and hugged her slender waist.

Their eyes met, and the two of them could even smell each other’s unique scent.

Time froze again.

Her heartbeat kept accelerating.

Following that, the two of them seemed to be attracted to each other as they continued to approach each other…

It was late at night.

Coiling Dragon Villa was extremely noisy.

It was endless!

…

The next day, Lin Fan opened his eyes when a ray of sunlight shone on the windowsill.

He glanced at the bright red stain on the white bed and picked up his phone out of habit.

A text message appeared on the screen as usual.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 3,560,000 yuan was deposited into your account.]

Then, Lin Fan slowly got up and walked out.

At this moment, the dining table was already filled with fried dumplings, buns, eggs, and other delicacies.

Lin Fan said, “You were so tired last night. You should rest well today.”

Speaking of last night, Su Ningjing immediately thought of something. Her entire pretty face blushed, and she wished she could bury her entire head in her clothes.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan wanted to laugh.

After breakfast, Lin Fan and Su Ningjing spent some time together.

At this moment, his phone rang.

“Brother, I’m in Jiangbei!” As soon as he picked up the call, he heard his sister, Lin Xiaoyao’s, excited voice.

“What? Why are you in Jiangbei?” Lin Fan asked curiously.

“Brother, shouldn’t you be very happy to hear that your sister is in Jiangbei?” Lin Xiaoyao pouted and complained.

Lin Fan said, “I’m happy! Of course, I’m happy! But shouldn’t you be in school?”

“I finished our final exams yesterday and have a day off today, so I came to Jiangbei with two classmates,” Lin Xiaoyao said excitedly.

Lin Fan nodded his head and said, “Okay, where are you? I’ll pick you up now!”

“Alright! I’m getting off at East Station later!” Lin Xiaoyao cheered.

After hanging up the phone, Lin Fan walked out and sat in the Mercedes-Benz. He stepped on the accelerator and sped into the distance.
